description: ConvNeXt-Tiny with DINOv3 self-supervised initialisation (frozen backbone, linear head fitted by logistic regression)
output: one logit; sigmoid(logit) is the (uncalibrated) AI-generated score

input.preprocessing: EXIF-transpose, RGB, centre square crop, bicubic resize to 256, centre crop 224, normalise

training.method: frozen backbone + logistic regression (standardised features), head folded into the final layer
